Context: 5. Monthly subscription and amount of Insurance Cover:-

- GIO (1), Para. 5.4.  
- (A) Applicable to all employees who were members of the Scheme on 31-1-1989 and have opted to continue to subscribe at the old rates.
- (8) Applicable to all employees who were members of the Scheme on 31-1-1989 and have opted to subscribe at the revised rate with effect from 1-1-1990 and to those who joined service on or after 1-2-1989.  
- Paras. 5.1 and 5.2.
